cd /Users/dct/.factory/missions/e194b9e3-6a67-42b9-bfc9-dd4e1ac23b0c; cp contract-work/metrics.md /tmp/metrics.before.md
/usr/bin/python3 - <<'E'
p='contract-work/metrics.md'; s=open(p).read()
note="> SUPERSEDED HEADER (2026-10-30, inbox 0045): this derived file still shows the pre-F-033 21-name metrics header. The contract of record is `validation-contract.md` VAL-METRIC-001 (line ~1082): 22 names, `throttled_minutes` at position 16. Read the contract, not this file.\n\n"
open(p,'w').write(note+s)
p='contract-work/m4-boundary-questions.md'; s=open(p).read()
a="| answered via record; owner morning (oracle draft header) |"
assert s.count(a)==1
s=s.replace(a,"| closed | delegate 00:45 (inbox 0045): 0016 withdrawn; delegate had read the pre-F-033 header in contract-work/metrics.md; oracle draft switched to the 22-name header, compared byte for byte against contract line 1082 before the owner sees it |")
if not s.endswith('\n'): s+='\n'
s+="\n| 60 | Rule 30 gap: the m5-time-states-and-rework-core hand-off (8a7c35d6, fea57ff) carries no `claims` list and its staging file has no `## Claims (rule 30)` section; the tests block's per-case 'verifies' lines are the nearest evidence. Disposition: scrutiny-validator-m5 grades the slice's fulfills from the tests and commits; workers from m5-cost-and-tokens-core on are reminded (AGENTS `## M5 rules` bullet below); no re-run. | m5-time-states-and-rework-core hand-off 8a7c35d6; WT reports/staging/m5-time-states-and-rework-core.md | recorded |\n"
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='AGENTS.md'; s=open(p).read()
a="- **Budgets are notification stops (rule 29, D-045)."
assert s.count(a)==1
s=s.replace(a,"- **Rule 30 in every hand-off:** `claims: [{assertion, evidence}]` for every fulfilled assertion AND a `## Claims (rule 30)` section in the staging file (first M5 slice omitted both; validators grade from tests when missing, but do not omit it).\n"+a)
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='contract-work/progress.md'; s=open(p).read()
assert "25 files (0030)" in s
s=s.replace("25 files (0030)","26 files (0045)")
if not s.endswith('\n'): s+='\n'
s+="- 00:45 inbox 0045: 0016 withdrawn, oracle draft on the 22-name header; row 57 closed; row 60 rule-30 gap recorded.\n"
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
diff /tmp/metrics.before.md contract-work/metrics.md | head -5 | cut -c1-80; diff <(tail -n +3 contract-work/metrics.md) /tmp/metrics.before.md && echo "rest identical"
grep -n '^| 57 ' contract-work/m4-boundary-questions.md | grep -o 'closed |.\{40\}'; grep -c '^| 60 ' contract-work/m4-boundary-questions.md; grep -c 'Rule 30 in every hand-off' AGENTS.md; grep -n '26 files' contract-work/progress.md | cut -c1-60
